security_spec.violation_condition: In the Linux kernel, ptrace vtype validation (arch/riscv/kernel/ptrace.c:150) masks writable bits as (VTYPE_VSEW | VTYPE_VLMUL | VTYPE_VMA | VTYPE_VTA), which excludes the Zvfbfa altfmt field at bit 8. A debugger attempting to round-trip a tracee's vtype that has altfmt=1 will be rejected with -EINVAL. Additionally, if altfmt is later allowed without also validating the reserved combination altfmt=1 && SEW>=32, a debugger could inject an invalid vtype that causes the tracee to trap with vill on the next vector instruction.
security_spec.summary: Zvfbfa adds altfmt field at vtype bit 8; kernel ptrace validation does not include altfmt in the writable mask, blocking debugger save/restore of Zvfbfa vector state
